race.description: The Traitors Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: DEBRIEFING (12) makes her debut and earns top billing on the strength of a comfortable Muswellbrook trial win, with the Ben Blay stable having a useful small-sample debut record. Race pressure is the unknown, but the trial says she is forward enough for a maiden of this shape. COSMIC JINKS (11) is the best exposed danger after being beaten a nose as favourite at Wellington and she should be fitter again third-up. MARKWELL TOPSORT (3) resumes after placing in all four starts, including a third at Port Macquarie and a head second at Taree, so his consistency reads well if he returns sharp enough. FRATIANNO (2) is hard to knock for honesty, with ten placings from 20 starts and excuses when second at Moree, but the long maiden record keeps him just behind the main trio. WARRAWEE (13) resumes and looks best of the rest.
